# Get exclusive pre-release access to Everest Group’s latest research


Get your copy below


## AI is changing how customer journeys are delivered.


**Download the pre-release Everest Group research, sponsored by Concentrix for a practical framework you can use to understand:**


- Where AI is ready to take the lead
- What separates experimentation from scalable transformation


- Where AI should strengthen human-led delivery


- How to build operating models ready for AI-enabled customer journeys


The real challenge isn’t adopting AI. It’s deciding what to evolve, what to reinvent, and how to scale both successfully.


### Download the report.


No form required. Get instant access.


[Download](https://www.concentrix.com/resource/everest-reinvent-or-evolve-intelligent-operating-models-sc/)


## Read the research. Then join the conversation.


As you’ll see, the report shares there are implications for every business, but the real challenge is understanding what those implications mean for your organisation.


We’d love for you to join Concentrix experts Ali Fry and Dave Pattman for a live, interactive briefing and Q&A on what the report’s findings mean in practice.


We’ll explore:


- Where to evolve existing customer journeys—and where to reinvent them
- The data, technology and governance foundations needed to scale AI
- Where human judgement remains essential—and where AI can take a greater role
- How to move beyond pilots without creating new operational complexity


**Date** : Monday, 28 September 2026
**Time** : 9AM New York | 2PM London | 3PM Paris
**Duration** : 1 hour
**Location** : Zoom


Whether you’re shaping strategy, leading transformation, or assessing the impact of AI on your organisation, this session is an opportunity to pressure-test your thinking, challenge assumptions, and sharpen your priorities for 2027. We encourage you to bring your questions, as we’ll leave plenty of time for discussion and practical application of the findings.


**Secure your spot today.**

" indicates required fields


## Our Speakers


#### Dave Pattman
Vice President of Transformation, Concentrix


Dave leads narrative framing, leadership implications, and the strategic view of how organisations evolve from managing people to orchestrating human and digital workforces. Drawing on insights from Concentrix’s work with more than 2,000 of the world’s leading brands, alongside the company’s own transformation journey, he’ll share what separates AI ambition from operational advantage, where leadership teams should focus their attention, and the decisions organisations need to make as work itself continues to evolve.


#### Ali Fry


#### Global Vice President of Technology & Partners, Concentrix


Ali works at the intersection of AI, technology innovation and strategic partnerships, helping organisations navigate the shift from traditional operating models to AI-enabled enterprises. Drawing on Concentrix’s Agentic Operating Framework, he’ll help leaders identify where AI should enhance and evolve existing customer journeys, where more fundamental reinvention is required, and how to build the foundations for humans and AI agents to work together effectively at scale.
